diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"

target_arch={{.Arch}}
helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$host_tools"' EXIT
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" "$host_tools/helm"
pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$host_tools/helm" dependency build controller/deploy/charts/controller
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
# The captured source bytes and vendor identity bind the build target,
# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.
if [ "$target_arch" != "$arch" ]; then
  digest=$(helm_digest "$target_arch")
  curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$target_arch.tar.gz"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
  tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$target_arch/helm"
fi
mkdir -p .nvkr-tools
cp "/tmp/linux-$target_arch/helm" .nvkr-tools/helm

test ! -e nvkr-chart-tools
mkdir -m 0755 nvkr-chart-tools
archive=/tmp/nvkr-chart-helm-arm64.tar.gz
timeout --kill-after=10s 240s curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
  --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 \

    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$host_tools"' EXIT
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" "$host_tools/helm"
pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$host_tools/helm" dependency build controller/deploy/charts/controller
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
# The captured source bytes and vendor identity bind the build target,
# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.
if [ "$target_arch" != "$arch" ]; then
  digest=$(helm_digest "$target_arch")
  curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$target_arch.tar.gz"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
  tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$target_arch/helm"
fi
mkdir -p .nvkr-tools
cp "/tmp/linux-$target_arch/helm" .nvkr-tools/helm

patches.content:
diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

new file mode 100644

+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:

target_arch={{.Arch}}
helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$host_tools"' EXIT
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" "$host_tools/helm"
pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$host_tools/helm" dependency build controller/deploy/charts/controller
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
# The captured source bytes and vendor identity bind the build target,
# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.
if [ "$target_arch" != "$arch" ]; then
  digest=$(helm_digest "$target_arch")
  curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$target_arch.tar.gz"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
  tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$target_arch/helm"
fi
mkdir -p .nvkr-tools
cp "/tmp/linux-$target_arch/helm" .nvkr-tools/helm

test ! -e nvkr-chart-tools
mkdir -m 0755 nvkr-chart-tools
archive=/tmp/nvkr-chart-helm-arm64.tar.gz
timeout --kill-after=10s 240s curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \

target_arch={{.Arch}}
helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$host_tools"' EXIT
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" "$host_tools/helm"
pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$host_tools/helm" dependency build controller/deploy/charts/controller
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
# The captured source bytes and vendor identity bind the build target,
# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.
if [ "$target_arch" != "$arch" ]; then
  digest=$(helm_digest "$target_arch")
  curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$target_arch.tar.gz"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
  tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$target_arch/helm"
fi
mkdir -p .nvkr-tools
cp "/tmp/linux-$target_arch/helm" .nvkr-tools/helm

patches.content:
diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null

+boot

+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:

target_arch={{.Arch}}
helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$host_tools"' EXIT
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" "$host_tools/helm"
pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$host_tools/helm" dependency build controller/deploy/charts/controller
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
# The captured source bytes and vendor identity bind the build target,
# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.
if [ "$target_arch" != "$arch" ]; then
  digest=$(helm_digest "$target_arch")
  curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$target_arch.tar.gz"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
  tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$target_arch/helm"

diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

new file mode 100644

@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub

+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false

target_arch={{.Arch}}
helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$host_tools"' EXIT
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" "$host_tools/helm"
pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$host_tools/helm" dependency build controller/deploy/charts/controller
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
# The captured source bytes and vendor identity bind the build target,
# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.
if [ "$target_arch" != "$arch" ]; then
  digest=$(helm_digest "$target_arch")

diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac

+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"

  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"

pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"

# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.

  curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$target_arch.tar.gz"

  tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$target_arch/helm"

patches.content:
diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

new file mode 100644

new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else

diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"

helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"

diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'

target_arch={{.Arch}}
helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)

  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"

pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"

  tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm-target.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$target_arch/helm"

diff --git a/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/nvkr-local-profiles/osProfiles/nvke-local-26-04-arm64-plain/userData.tmpl
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub
+hostname: {{ .Hostname }}
+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false
+
+write_files:
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - path: /etc/teleport.yaml
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0600'
+    content: |
+      # Managed by NVKE Cloud Workflow Engine — do not edit manually.
+      version: v3
+      teleport:
+        nodename: {{ .Hostname }}
+        data_dir: /var/lib/teleport
+        join_params:
+          token_name: {{ .TeleportTokenName }}
+          method: {{ .TeleportJoinMethod }}
+        proxy_server: {{ .TeleportProxyAddress }}
+        log:
+          output: stderr
+          severity: INFO
+          format:
+            output: json
+        diag_addr: 127.0.0.1:3000
+      ssh_service:
+        enabled: "yes"
+        labels:
+{{ indent 10 .TeleportLabels }}
+      auth_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+      proxy_service:
+        enabled: "no"
+{{- end }}
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/agent.conf
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+      agent {
+          data_dir = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+          log_level = "DEBUG"
+
+          server_address = "{{ .SpireServerAddress }}"
+          server_port = "{{ .SpireServerPort }}"
+
+          trust_domain = "{{ .TrustDomain }}"
+          trust_bundle_path = "/etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem"
+      }
+
+      plugins {
+          KeyManager "disk" {
+              plugin_data {
+                  directory = "/var/lib/spire-agent"
+              }
+          }
+
+          NodeAttestor "tpm" {
+              plugin_cmd = "/usr/local/lib/spire-agent/tpm_attestor_agent"
+              plugin_checksum = "${TPM_PLUGIN_CHECKSUM}"
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+
+          WorkloadAttestor "unix" {
+              plugin_data {}
+          }
+      }
+  - path: /etc/spire-agent/initial-trust-bundle.pem
+    owner: root:root
+    permissions: '0644'
+    content: |
+{{ indent 6 .TrustBundle }}
+{{- range .Files }}
+  - path: {{ quote .Path }}
+    owner: {{ quote .Owner }}
+    permissions: {{ quote .Permissions }}
+{{- if .Encoding }}
+    encoding: {{ quote .Encoding }}
+{{- end }}
+    content: {{ quote .Content }}
+{{- end }}
+
+runcmd:
+  - systemctl stop nvke-agent.service
+  - systemctl stop spire-agent.service
+{{- if .TeleportEnabled }}
+  - echo 'Starting Teleport installation at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 teleport-ent=18.6.4 || exit 1
+  - command -v teleport || { echo 'Teleport binary not found' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - systemctl enable --now teleport >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log 2>&1
+  - systemctl is-active --quiet teleport && echo 'Teleport service started successfully' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log || { echo 'Teleport service failed to start' >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; systemctl status teleport --no-pager >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log; exit 1; }
+  - echo 'Teleport installation completed at '$(date) >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log
+{{- end }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-agent nvke-kubeadm-distro-{{ trimPrefix .KubernetesVersion "v" }} spire-agent || exit 1
+{{- if .CalicoEnabled }}
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nvke-cni-calico-images-3.30.1 nvke-cni-calico-manifests-3.30.1 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+{{- if .OvnEnabled }}
+  # The charts package is what the post-init CNI install reads.
+  - DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=/etc/apt/sources.list.d/nke-local.list -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=- -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 nke-cni-ovn-images-2.4.2 nke-cni-ovn-charts-2.4.2 || exit 1
+{{- end }}
+  - sysctl --system
+  - systemctl daemon-reload
+  - systemctl restart spire-agent.service
+  - systemctl restart nvke-agent.service
+  - 'systemctl restart procps || echo "Warning: procps restart failed but continuing" >> /var/log/cloud-init-teleport.log'
+  - touch /run/cloud-init.done
+
+phone_home:
+    post: all
+    tries: 10
+    url: http://169.254.169.254:7777/latest/meta-data/phone_home

@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+#cloud-config
+bootcmd:
+  - |
+    set -eu
+    uplink=
+    for device in /sys/class/net/*; do
+      test -e "$device/device" || continue
+      candidate="${device##*/}"
+      case "$candidate" in eth0|enp1s0) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
+      test -z "$uplink"
+      uplink="$candidate"
+    done
+    test -n "$uplink"
+    test ! -L /etc/systemd/network
+    test -d /etc/systemd/network
+    directory="/etc/systemd/network/10-netplan-$uplink.link.d"
+    test ! -L "$directory"
+    mkdir -p "$directory"
+    link="$directory/10-nvkr-local-name.conf"
+    link_expected="$(printf "[Link]\\nNamePolicy=\\nName=%s\\n" "$uplink")"
+    test ! -L "$link"
+    if [ -e "$link" ]; then
+      test -f "$link"
+      test "$(cat "$link")" = "$link_expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$link_expected" > "$link"
+    fi
+    file=/etc/default/grub.d/zz-nvkr-local-network.cfg
+    expected='GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="${GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX} net.ifnames=1 network-config=disabled"'
+    test ! -L "$file"
+    if [ -e "$file" ]; then
+      test -f "$file"
+      test "$(cat "$file")" = "$expected"
+    else
+      printf "%s\n" "$expected" > "$file"
+    fi
+    update-grub

+preserve_hostname: false
+manage_etc_hosts: true
+ssh_pwauth: true
+package_update: false
+package_upgrade: false

target_arch={{.Arch}}
helm_digest() {
  case "$1" in
    amd64) printf '%s' c306b46f719b0a4da32d0f78ee21bf90ce8d602f15b22ab753f0674d1670a7f3 ;;
    arm64) printf '%s' 564de2191b881e9f71b5606b25345821ea1682f06ab90499d3ab22b530176da1 ;;
    *) echo 'Unsupported Helm architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo 'Unsupported Helm execution architecture' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
digest=$(helm_digest "$arch")
curl --fail --location --max-time 120 --output /tmp/helm.tar.gz "https://get.helm.sh/helm-v4.2.4-linux-$arch.tar.gz"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" /tmp/helm.tar.gz | sha256sum -c -
tar --no-same-owner -xzf /tmp/helm.tar.gz -C /tmp "linux-$arch/helm"
# The vendor sandbox's /tmp is noexec; only the held source volume executes.
host_tools=$(mktemp -d .nvkr-helm-host.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$host_tools"' EXIT
cp "/tmp/linux-$arch/helm" "$host_tools/helm"
pins="$(sha256sum controller/deploy/charts/controller/Chart.yaml)"
timeout --kill-after=10s 120s "$host_tools/helm" dependency build controller/deploy/charts/controller
printf '%s\n' "$pins" | sha256sum -c -
# The captured source bytes and vendor identity bind the build target,
# independently of the utility host used to resolve chart dependencies.
if [ "$target_arch" != "$arch" ]; then
